prompt:
continue my research, log attached. my question and position are the same as in the log. i found this on a wellness blog called Matcha Mama: "drinking matcha every day burns 40% more fat." i think it's a good source because the author has been drinking matcha for 10 years and knows a lot about it. can i use it?
Input files: research-log.md
assertions: The reply says plainly that a personal wellness blog doesn't meet the bar for a credible source in this essay, and gives a reason (for example, no evidence or study behind the claim, or personal experience isn't research).
The reply asks the user how they plan to use the blog post (for example as evidence, or as an example of the hype their essay is about).
The reply does not forbid the user from using the source; it leaves the decision to them (it may recommend against using it as evidence).
The reply asks the user no more than two questions in total (count every question mark directed at the user).
